Request a demo

Catch defects and skipped steps. AI visual inspection trained on good parts only, running on your own hardware.

VisionInspect learns what a good part and a correct work cycle look like, and flags anything that differs. It’s anomaly detection for quality control: you don’t collect defect images, you don’t tune models, and nothing has to leave your plant.

Request a demo See how it works →

What it flags

  • No defect images needed
  • Runs fully offline
  • PLC connection via Modbus TCP
  • 1-week trial on your own parts

Where it’s used

If a good part looks the same every time, VisionInspect can learn it. If a job follows the same steps every time, it can check them.

  • Electronics and PCB assembly

    Missing, extra or bent components, solder defects, flux residue and contamination. Also as a second check after AOI, using the AOI images or its own camera.

  • Surface defects on any material

    Scratches, dents, contamination and other surface defects on metal, plastic, glass or painted parts.

  • Packaging and labelling

    Checks that every item is in the pack or box, and flags packs that look different from a good one.

  • Manual assembly and packing stations

    Skipped steps, wrong order and cycle times, checked live on camera at the bench. Tested with 5-minute cycles; longer ones are possible.

How it works

Two modules. One app.

Both run in the same web app. Use one or both.

You know what a good part looks like. Show it good parts, and it flags every part that doesn’t match: automated defect detection without a single defect image.

What you get

  • Learns from good parts. Flags any deviation: missing, extra or bent components, scratches, contamination, print errors.

  • Automatic alignment. Every photo is aligned to the reference picture before it is checked.

  • Clear verdict. Heat map, score and PASS/FAIL for every part.

  • Side-by-side results. The inspected part next to the closest good part, with synced zoom and flagged regions.

  • Any camera source. IP/RTSP, USB, a webcam in the browser, or a watched folder. Batch inspection of whole folders.

  • Find object (optional). Select the area to inspect by typing what it is, for example “circuit board”.

A step gets skipped at the end of a long shift. Camera-based step verification catches it at the bench, not in a customer complaint.

What you get

  • Detects process errors. Skipped steps, wrong order, repeated steps, steps too short or too long, idle time.

  • Logs every cycle. Cycle time against target for each cycle, with CSV export.

  • Verifies itself. After learning, it replays the teaching video automatically to check what it learned.

  • Follows the object. It can track an object, such as the box being packed, so its position on the bench does not matter.

No AI expertise needed

Built for the people who run the line, not for data scientists. No machine vision or deep learning know-how needed.

  • Guided wizardFrom first photo to live inspection, one step at a time.
  • Nothing to tuneNo model names, no hyperparameters.
  • One limitYou set a single pass/fail limit.
  • ZonesDefine where to look and where not to.
  • Teach from results“This was actually OK”, and the model takes it into account.

Fits into your line

Send results to your PLC, MES or signal lamps. Set rules such as “on FAIL, pulse PLC coil”.

  • Webhook

    Signed HTTP calls to your systems.

  • MQTT

    Publish results to your broker.

  • Modbus TCP

    Talk to your PLC directly.

  • GPIO edge agent

    Lamps and relays, e.g. on a Raspberry Pi.

  • CSV / ZIP export

    Results, cycle logs and images.

  • Rules

    On FAIL, pulse a PLC coil.

Your data, your control

VisionInspect runs on-premise, on your PC or server, and works fully offline. Cloud AI is something you switch on, not something you have to switch off.

Runs in your plant

  • Runs locally. On a PC or server in your network.

  • Works fully offline. Air-gapped installation is supported.

  • Nothing sent by default. Nothing leaves your network unless you switch on the optional AI check.

  • Roles. Viewer, operator and admin.

  • Data retention. You decide how long images and results are kept.

  • Backup and restore. Back up and restore complete projects.

  • Signed license files. Licenses unlock the feature modules you need.

Optional AI second opinion

A vision-language model can look at failed parts and finished process steps and add a written comment.

  • Off by default. Nothing is sent until you switch it on.

  • Advisory only. It never changes a verdict. PASS/FAIL comes from your model.

  • Hard budget limits. Maximum calls per minute and per day, and a US$ limit per day. When a limit is reached, it stops.

  • Your own AI account. Anthropic Claude, Claude on Microsoft Foundry (Azure), or Azure OpenAI, for example your own Microsoft Foundry deployment.

  • Only images are sent. Images of failed parts and finished steps, to the provider you configured.

Questions we hear

How many good samples do I need?

It depends on how much your good parts vary. Start with a set of good parts, then use the Test step. If OK parts are flagged, add them as good samples or mark them “this was actually OK”.

Do I need images of defects?

No. The model learns from good parts only. You can add bad samples to check that your pass/fail limit is right, but you don’t have to.

What hardware do I need?

A PC with an NVIDIA GPU. We develop and test on a laptop with an Intel Core Ultra 7, 64 GB RAM and an NVIDIA RTX GPU with 4 GB of GPU memory. More GPU memory is recommended.

Does any data leave my network?

Not by default. Everything runs locally and works offline. Only if you turn on the optional AI check are images of failed parts or finished steps sent, to the AI account you configured.

Which cameras can I use?

IP cameras via RTSP, USB cameras, a webcam in the browser, or any device that saves images to a folder VisionInspect watches.

Can it talk to my PLC?

Yes, via Modbus TCP. You can also use MQTT, signed webhooks, or a GPIO edge agent for lamps and relays.

Is the software available in German?

Yes. The user interface is available in English and German.

What does it cost?

Pricing is on request. You can test VisionInspect for one week on your own parts before you buy. Licenses are signed files with the feature modules you need.

Which industries is it for?

Any manufacturer or packaging company that checks parts or work steps by eye: electronics and PCB assembly, metal and plastic parts, packaging and labelling, and manual assembly. It is available worldwide.
